whatIs: uiGradients is a community collection of gradients with two or more colors. You can browse them one by one, change their direction, copy the CSS code or download one as an image.
It's a good fit when you want a gradient that looks good without designing it yourself.
uses: Putting a gradient background on a landing page or a hero.
Adding color to buttons or cards with a gradient that's already proven.
Looking for color combination inspiration for a brand.
caveats: It's a closed collection: it doesn't create gradients from your own colors.
If you want to contribute one, you do it with a pull request on GitHub by adding a name and its HEX colors.
pricingNote: Open collection under the MIT license.
idealFor: Picking a ready-made gradient for a background or a button.
